orders.title: Little Missouri National Grassland - Fire Restriction Order 01-18-00-26-08
orders.summary: This Fire Restriction Order for the Little Missouri National Grasslands covers the National Forest System lands in Slope, Golden Valley, Billings, and McKenzie counties and is effective from September 4 through December 31, 2026. For details, contact local ranger district offices.

orders.title: Road Closure-NFSR 735A-9
orders.summary: Effective July 10, 2026 at 5:00 PM MDT, the Medora Ranger District has closed National Forest System Road (NFSR) 735A‑9 due to road damage that poses public safety concerns. The closure will remain in place through December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM MST, unless rescinded earlier.
